_comment: Scalpel feature backlog — debloater + systemizer with multi-mode auto-detection

features.title: Config system with migration
features.description: Read/write/migrate persistent config in /data/adb/scalpel/config.sh. Support mode override, options, backup for bootloop recovery.
features.notes: 174 lines. Security-hardened: eval removed, safe sourcing, atomic writes. Validated by Red Team Rex (2 critical + 3 high fixed).

features.title: Structured logging with rotation
features.description: 5-level logging (debug/info/warn/error/fatal) to /data/adb/scalpel/debug.log. 1MB max, 3 archives. kmsg mirror for boot-time issues.
features.notes: 87 lines. 5-level logging, kmsg mirror, 1MB rotation. Validated by Red Team Rex.

features.title: 3-strike bootloop protection
features.description: Counter in post-fs-data, reset in service.sh. If counter ≥ 3: restore config backup, delete whiteouts, disable module, reboot. Must work without busybox.
features.notes: 85 lines. Zero external dependencies. 3-strike counter with config backup restore.

features.title: Mode detection probe chain
features.description: Probe device capabilities at boot: ZeroMount (/dev/zeromount) → overlayfs+tmpfs xattr → overlayfs → magic mount → pm fallback. Return mode identifier. Support config override.
features.notes: 176 lines. 6-mode probe chain with config override validation.

features.title: System app scanner (runs at install, on-demand refresh)
features.description: Scan all system partitions dynamically from /proc/mounts. Extract package name (pm/aapt), app label (aapt), icon (unzip). Output app_list.json via jq. Categorize via categories.json. Runs ONCE during customize.sh, cached for WebUI. Manual refresh via WebUI button.
features.notes: 182 lines. Dynamic partition discovery, pm-first strategy, jq JSON output.

features.title: Mode: pm disable/uninstall fallback
features.description: Universal fallback mode. pm disable-user --user 0 for debloat, pm enable for restore. Verify via pm list packages -d. Implements mode interface (probe/debloat/restore/verify/cleanup).
features.notes: 82 lines. Reference mode implementation, defines interface contract for all other modes.

features.title: Mode: overlayfs whiteouts
features.description: Create char device (c 0 0) with trusted.overlay.whiteout xattr. Copy SELinux context from original. Handle vendor partition symlinks. Implements mode interface.
features.notes: Primary debloat mechanism for stock kernels

features.title: Mode: ZeroMount VFS interception
features.description: Detect /dev/zeromount, use zm CLI (zm add/del) to register whiteout paths. Top-tier detection resistance. Implements mode interface.
features.notes: Cleanest mode — zero mount table entries

features.title: Mode: Magisk magic mount
features.description: Place whiteout files in module dir, Magisk auto-mounts at boot. Used for systemization (APK in module/system/). Implements mode interface.
features.notes: Required for systemizer on Magisk devices

features.title: Mode: standalone mountify (tmpfs+overlayfs)
features.description: Create tmpfs, copy whiteouts, set SELinux contexts, mount overlayfs per directory. Covers more partitions than default manager mount.
features.notes: mode_mountify.sh built. tmpfs+overlayfs standalone mount per partition.

features.title: Mode: symlink + overlayfs
features.description: Create symlink to module dir, mount overlayfs per directory. Simpler alternative to mountify for overlayfs-native root managers.
features.notes: mode_symlink.sh built. Empty opaque directory technique for overlayfs-native managers.

features.title: Clinical systemization engine
features.description: Copy APK + splits to module/system/{app|priv-app}/. Copy native libs (correct ABI). Set permissions + SELinux. pm uninstall -k --user 0. Handle multi-user. Verify FLAG_SYSTEM + sourceDir after reboot.
features.notes: 193 lines. 9-step clinical systemization with pm uninstall -k --user 0. Fixes Terminal Systemizer's fatal flaw.

features.title: Priv-app permissions XML generator
features.description: Parse APK via aapt d permissions, generate /system/etc/permissions/privapp-permissions-<pkg>.xml. Validate output before writing.
features.notes: 138 lines. aapt + dumpsys fallback for permission extraction. XML validation before write.

features.title: post-fs-data.sh boot entry
features.description: Boot entry point: source bootloop.sh, source detect.sh, execute active mode's debloat operations. Root manager detection at boot.
features.notes: 24 lines. Minimal early boot: bootloop check -> config -> log -> nuke. pm mode failure expected here.

features.title: service.sh late boot orchestration
features.description: Wait boot_completed, reset boot counter, verify operations, start monitor, update module.prop description. NO scanning — app_list.json generated at install.
features.notes: ~85 lines. Wait boot_completed with 300s timeout, reset counter, pm retry with forced override, verify.

features.title: customize.sh installation logic
features.description: Detect root manager, detect device capabilities, write initial config, migrate existing config, place binaries (aapt, jq) by arch, run system app scanner (one-time generation).
features.notes: 125 lines. Scanner + volume key default debloat + binary placement + config migration.

features.title: Default debloat list with volume key prompt
features.description: During customize.sh: display curated default nuke list (package names). Volume key prompt: UP=apply, DOWN=skip. 7-second timeout=SKIP (safe default). If applied, write nuke_list.json. Uses getevent for key detection. Package names provided by user. LAST backend task before WebUI.
features.notes: 81 lines. Extracts safe+google apps from categories.json via jq. Volume key prompt in customize.sh.

features.title: Background monitor daemon
features.description: Poll for module/app state changes (5s interval). Detect installs via inotifywait/logcat/poll fallback. Update status cache JSON. Process camouflage optional.
features.notes: monitor.sh built. inotifywait/logcat/poll fallback chain. 5s polling interval.

features.title: WebUI scaffold (fork ZeroMount webroot-beta)
features.description: Fork ZeroMount's webroot-beta/ as starting point. Reuse bridge.ts, theme system, component library, Vite config, icon loading. Strip ZeroMount-specific tabs. Add tab navigation: Debloat, Systemize, Status, Settings. Add floating reboot FAB button with confirmation dialog.
features.notes: Fork, don't rebuild. Reuse ZeroMount's proven components. FAB reboot button included.

features.title: WebUI debloat tab
features.description: App list with lazy loading, category badges (essential/caution/safe/google/unknown), fuzzy search, multi-select, confirmation dialog with risk warnings, nuke button.

features.title: WebUI systemize tab
features.description: List user-installed apps, select target (app/priv-app), promote button, status verification after reboot.

features.title: WebUI status tab
features.description: Active mode display, debloated app count, systemized app count, bootloop counter, module health, last operation log.

features.title: WebUI settings tab
features.description: Mode override, theme selection, accent colors, logging toggle, clear all operations, export/import config.

features.title: App categorization database
features.description: Extend SAN's 292-app categories.json. 5 risk categories: essential (brick risk), caution, safe, google, unknown. Bundle with module.
features.notes: 692 apps classified across 5 risk tiers, 8 OEMs. Validated by Prof. Rigor (5 misclassifications fixed).

features.title: uninstall.sh cleanup and restoration
features.description: Restore all debloated apps (pm install-existing + pm enable). Remove /data/adb/scalpel/. Clean up modules_update staging.
features.notes: 42 lines. Restores apps via pm install-existing + pm enable, cleans /data/adb/scalpel/.

features.title: action.sh Magisk WebUI launcher
features.description: Check for KSUWebUIStandalone or MMRL, download if missing, launch via am start. Magisk-only entry point for WebUI.
features.notes: action.sh built. KSUWebUIStandalone/MMRL detection + download + launch.
